diagram_previews.alt: A non-convex pentagon shaped like a block with a V-shaped notch cut from the top, with the notch vertex V. A red horizontal line crosses the boundary at four red points; on it, the black points P (inside the left part), R (in the notch, outside the polygon) and Q (inside the right part) are marked.
